generic.match: No Verse\.SoundDef named .* found to give to
generic.summary: a def names a SoundDef that no active mod defines; the game uses no sound
causes: the sound comes from a DLC or mod that is not active
the sound was renamed in an update

generic.summary: a def references another def by name that no active mod defines
causes: the providing mod or DLC is not active (often an optional patch without MayRequire)
the def was renamed or removed in an update
a load-order problem when a patch adds the reference

generic.match: Failed to find \S+ named .* There are
generic.summary: code asked DefDatabase for a def by name that does not exist
causes: a C# mod hard-codes a def from a mod or DLC that is not active
renamed def after an update

generic.match: Could not load reference to \S+ named
generic.summary: the save refers to a def that no longer exists
causes: a mod was removed or a def renamed after the save was made

generic.match: Could not resolve reference to object with loadID
generic.summary: the save refers to an object that was not loaded
causes: a mod that owned the object was removed or its data changed
a mod's save data is corrupt
route: analyze_log cluster=E<n> (curParent names the owning type)

generic.match: Could not find think node with key
generic.summary: the save's AI state refers to think-tree nodes that changed
causes: a think-tree patcher was added or removed since the save
duplicate think-node keys

generic.match: is referenced .* but is not deep-saved
generic.summary: a reference is saved without its object
causes: a mod saves a reference to a pawn or lord it does not own

generic.summary: the save has a map/game/world component of a mod that is not loaded
causes: a mod was removed after the save was made

generic.summary: other save-loading error
a FindMod patch (optional-mod patch) failed inside
causes: the target mod's defs changed
the patch is for another version of the target mod

generic.match: Failed to find a node with the given xpath
generic.summary: a patch operation found no node to change
causes: the target mod or DLC is inactive (unguarded optional patch)
the target was renamed in an update
the target loads after the patch
route: get_patches failed=true (reasons: target-inactive, target-missing, target-later, stale-name …)

generic.match: PatchOperationSequence: Error in the operation at
generic.summary: one operation of a patch sequence failed
causes: as patch.xpath, for the operation named

generic.summary: a mod's patch operation failed (the game's summary line, names the mod and the xpath)
causes: as patch.xpath: target inactive, renamed or loading later
a custom operation class whose condition failed

generic.summary: other patch failure
XML sets a field the def's class does not have
causes: the mod was written for another game version
a patch adds a field meant for a class from an inactive mod
a framework mod is missing or outdated

generic.match: Could not find (a )?type|Could not find type named|Could not find class
generic.summary: XML names a C# class that no loaded assembly has
causes: the framework mod that defines the class is not active or loads later
the class was renamed in an update

generic.summary: a def fails the game's config checks
causes: authoring mistake in the mod

generic.summary: a texture or sound file could not be read
causes: corrupt or unsupported file in the mod

generic.summary: a def file could not be loaded
causes: a class named by the XML is missing
malformed XML

generic.summary: other XML loading error
a texture or sound path names no file in any active mod
causes: the art comes from a mod or DLC that is not active
the mod ships the file under another path or case

generic.summary: a material without a texture (often an icon)
causes: a buildable def with uiIconColor but no icon path

generic.summary: a mod's DLL references an assembly that is not loaded
causes: a required framework mod is missing or loads later
the DLL is for another game version

generic.match: HarmonyException: Patching exception|Undefined target method|Patching exception in method|Exception patching|Failed to patch|Cannot instrument|couldn't find target instruction|Ambiguous match for HarmonyMethod|^Transpiler:
generic.summary: a Harmony patch could not be applied (target method missing or changed)
causes: the mod was built for another version of the game or of the target mod
the target mod is not active

generic.match: MissingMethodException|MissingFieldException|Method not found|Field not found|TypeLoadException|Could not resolve type|Could not load type|invalid vtable|ReflectionTypeLoadException
generic.summary: a DLL calls code that does not exist in the loaded game or dependency
causes: the mod or one of its dependencies is outdated
two copies of a library in different versions

generic.summary: a transpiler produced invalid code
causes: two transpilers on one method conflict
a transpiler for another game version

generic.match: Error in static constructor of|Error while instantiating a mod of type|TypeInitializationException
generic.summary: a mod's start-up code threw
causes: the mod's Harmony patching failed
a dependency is missing

generic.summary: an exception while ticking a pawn, thing or the world
causes: a comp added or removed during tick
a patch on the tick path

generic.match: Exception filling window|OnGUI|UIRootUpdate|Root level exception in Update|DoWindowContents
generic.summary: an exception in drawing the UI
causes: a UI patch from a mod
a window of a mod with missing data

generic.match: Error while generating pawn|generating pawn group|generating thing set
generic.summary: pawn generation failed
causes: a race, xenotype or apparel mod with incomplete defs
a patch on PawnGenerator

generic.summary: map or world generation step failed
causes: a map-generation mod or a missing def in a GenStep

generic.match: post-long-event|post-load event|PostLoadInit|post load init|SaveableFromNode exception|ExposeData|Exception loading from System\.Xml|loaded object directory|Exception spawning loaded thing|FinalizeLoading
generic.summary: an exception while loading a save or after a long event
causes: a mod's save data from another version
a mod removed or added mid-save

generic.match: Error while resolving references|Could not resolve cross refs
generic.summary: a def's ResolveReferences threw
causes: a def with missing fields its class expects

generic.match: An item with the same key
generic.summary: duplicate key in a dictionary
causes: two mods register the same thing
a duplicated def or ID

generic.summary: HugsLib's own log upload failed (not a mod problem)
Dubs Performance Analyzer reports its own status
an exception in pawn AI (think tree, job giver, job driver)
causes: a job or work-giver of a mod with missing data
a patch on the AI path

generic.summary: a map drawing layer failed
causes: a terrain or graphics mod
a patch on map drawing

generic.match: Could not instantiate or initialize a ThingComp|Could not instantiate inspector tab|Null method for
generic.summary: a comp, tab or worker class could not be created
causes: a class named by XML is missing or has no default constructor
the providing mod is outdated

generic.summary: a list was changed while iterating (often comps or a mod's cache)
causes: AllComps.Add/Remove during tick
a mod modifying a game list from a patch

generic.match: Failed to create texture because of invalid parameters
generic.summary: Unity rejected a texture (size or format)
causes: a texture-replacement or resizing mod
corrupt image in a mod

generic.match: Failed to resolve text|injecting translations|AutoTranslation|translate failed
generic.summary: a translation or text resolution failed
causes: a translation mod for another version of the translated mod

generic.summary: a fragment of a Harmony IL dump or a stack reference line (belongs to the error above it)
a mod logs its status as an error
a null reference in mod or game code
other exception
